definitions.explanation: A religious ceremony held to commemorate and pray for the deceased at specific intervals after death. Common occasions include the 7th day, 49th day, and annual anniversaries.

examples.japanese: {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}の{法要|ほうよう}を{営|いとな}んだ。
{法要|ほうよう}には{親族|しんぞく}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Relatives gathered for the memorial service.

examples.japanese: {一周忌|いっしゅうき}の{法要|ほうよう}を{行|おこな}う{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to hold the first anniversary memorial service.

notes:
{法要|ほうよう} is a Buddhist ceremony to commemorate the deceased.

KEY MEMORIAL OCCASIONS:
- {初七日|しょなのか}: 7th day
- {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}: 49th day (very important)
- {一周忌|いっしゅうき}: 1st anniversary
- {三回忌|さんかいき}: 3rd year (actually 2nd anniversary)
- {七回忌|ななかいき}: 7th year

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法要|ほうよう}を{営|いとな}む: to hold a memorial service
- {法要|ほうよう}に{参加|さんか}する: to attend a memorial service
